en.headline: Kowloon Tong records highest Aedes mosquito index in latest FEHD survey
en.dek: Eleven of 16 surveyed areas reached Level 2, indicating fairly extensive distribution of Aedes albopictus; the department issued three prosecutions and multiple statutory notices over breeding sites.
body: The Food and Environmental Hygiene Department released the second batch of August gravidtrap indexes for Aedes albopictus, covering 16 survey areas. Kowloon Tong recorded the highest first-phase gravidtrap index at 16.7 per cent, followed by Chai Wan at 16.1 per cent.

Eleven areas exceeded the 5 per cent threshold and were classified at Level 2, meaning the distribution of the mosquito was fairly extensive. Sha Tin town centre and Fo Tan posted the highest density index at 2.6, indicating a relatively higher number of adult mosquitoes in positive traps.

In follow-up inspections, the department found mosquito breeding in a construction site, a park and a public housing estate in Eastern District and initiated three prosecutions against the relevant contractor, venue management company and estate management company. It also issued three statutory notices in Kowloon City District requiring clearance of stagnant water.

The department said it would continue intensive control measures during the rainy season, including enhanced inspections, larval and adult mosquito treatment, and inter-departmental coordination. Residents were reminded to eliminate stagnant water at home and on premises to reduce breeding sites.

zh.headline: 八月第二批白紋伊蚊指數 九龍塘最高達16.7% 食環提三宗檢控
zh.dek: 16個監察地區中有11區屬第二級別，顯示白紋伊蚊分布頗為廣泛；東區及九龍城發現滋生地點並採取執法行動。
body: 食物環境衞生署公布八月份第二批白紋伊蚊誘蚊器指數及密度指數，涵蓋16個監察地區。九龍塘第一階段誘蚊器指數最高，達16.7%，其次為柴灣的16.1%。
共有11個地區誘蚊器指數超過5%，屬於黃色第二級別，代表白紋伊蚊分布頗為廣泛。沙田市中心及火炭的密度指數最高，達2.6，顯示在陽性誘蚊器中成蚊數量較多。
食環署跟進時，在東區一個地盤、一個公園及一個公共屋邨發現蚊子滋生情況，分別向地盤承建商、場地管理公司及屋邨管理公司提出共三宗檢控。九龍城區則就兩個公園及一個屋邨內的積水發出三張法定通知書，要求限期清除。
署方表示，雨季期間會繼續加強控蚊工作，包括密集巡查、清除滋生地、施放殺幼蟲劑及霧化處理，並與相關部門協調。市民應清除家居及樓宇範圍內的積水，減低蚊子滋生機會。
